text:
maia-docs: Opened PR for an IPsec strongSwan option for private/on-prem installs. Adds offline mirror checklist and packaging notes: https://git.internal/redwood/docs/pull/8210

ruz-infra: Can you paste the minimal conn example for IKEv2 + RSA certs? ops love one-file examples.

maia-docs: Pasted in PR and here:
```
conn redwood-site
  keyexchange=ikev2
  auto=add
  left=%defaultroute
  leftcert=site.crt
  right=redwood-gw.example.internal
  rightsubnet=10.50.0.0/16
  ike=aes256gcm16-prfsha384-modp2048
  esp=aes256gcm16
```

devon-packaging: Packaging note: Debian 11 dpkg edgecases and RHEL8 RPM minimal install flags. I'll add apt/yum offline commands.

maia-docs: Added apt-offline and `yumdownloader --destdir` snippets. Also included systemd override to wait for certs: `RequiresMountsFor=/etc/redwood/certs`.

olga-qa: QA: include steps to init SoftHSM token and a YubiHSM check. I can run smoke tests if those are present.

maia-docs: Added `softhsm2-util init-token` example and `yubihsm-shell list` command. Also warned not to reset YubiHSM during install; if reset, re-run `redwood-installer --repair-hsm`.

sam-ux: UX: show sha512 verification for offline bundles and exact commands.

maia-docs: Added `sha512sum redwood-offline-bundle-2.0.0.tar.gz` and note to verify MANIFEST and GPG signature.

deploy-bot: build-docs: success (sha: d4e5f6a) - preview: https://docs-preview.internal/6114445555

olga-qa: I'll test tomorrow morning and report issues.

maia-docs: Thanks all, will push minor wording fixes after QA.
